newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Tupperware EPS view cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Tupperware EPS view cut.

text.p: Mesirow Financial said it reduced earnings estimates for Tupperware Corp to $2.30 a share from $2.47 for 1997 and to $2.50 from $2.83 for 1998.
-- It cited poor results in U.S. markets coupled with expectations of a longer than expected time frame to return U.S. operations to profitability.

-- In a report dated Thursday, Mesirow said the unfavorable impact of foreign exchange should reduce earnings between $0.31 and $0.34 a share in 1997 versus prior expectations of between $0.22 and $0.24.
-- It added that Tupperware's second quarter results were in line with expectations at $0.61 a share versus $0.77 a year ago.
